headline: Brazil Ministry Study: Big Tech Regulations Could Save Up to R$50B Annually
summary: A study by Brazil's Ministry of Finance found that introducing pro-competition regulations for large digital platforms could reduce annual corporate and consumer costs by R$15.3 billion to R$50.6 billion.
why: Antitrust regulations targeting dominant online platforms could reduce digital payment fees and app marketplace commissions across Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Proposed antitrust rules could compress platform fees, generating up to R$50 billion in broader economic savings.
